tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

a. The Consultancy Firm / Company should have been involved in the Civil Engineering Consultancy Services for minimum 3 years. In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish Tax Registration Certificate along with the Technical Proposal.

b.Achieved at least in two Financial Years a minimum Average Financial Turnover in all classes of Civil Engineering Consultation Works only of Rs. 50 Lakhs during last 3 financial year i.e 2022-23 to 2025-26. Further, the Financial Turnover of the Previous Years shall be given a Weightage of 10 percent per year to bring them to the Price Level of 2026 and 27. In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish the Certificate from Chartered Accountant along with the Technical Proposal.

c. Each tender in its name should have been executed and completed successfully in Urban Conditions Project Management Consultancy for at least Two Any Building Work etc., for which the total Value of Construction project is not less than Rs. 20 Crores. During last 3 financial year i.e. 2022 and 23 to 2025 and 26. In support of this, the Tenderer shall furnish a Certificate duly certified by the Competent Authority of Rank not below the Executive Engineer along with the Technical Bid. Further, the Value of the Completed Works shall be given a Weightage of 10percent per year to bring them to the Price Level of 2026-27.

d. Consultants must have Key professionals required (as detailed in Terms of Reference) having experience in the construction of White Topping/Rigid Pavement Work/ Flexible Pavement/ Footpath work/Junction improvement works/Urban drain consisting of Roads, water supply, UGD, and other utilities to be deployed exclusively for this consultancy contract. The employer or competent authority shall furnish the CVs of the personnel and the availability of the personnel for the project till completion of the assignment.

e. Consultants have own or MOU well equipped With Minimum 75 Parameters Reinforcement laboratory accredited by NABL (in Bangalore apart from having their own or mou necessary infrastructure.) or NAAC Accreditation. (The Consultant / Firm participating in the bid should have their own or mou lab with NABL/NAAC.NABL or NAAC Accreditation and ISO certified or association with NABL Accredited lab equivalent or associated with NAAC Certified agency in Karnataka State Only
f. Consultants have ESI and EPF Registration Certificate and paid Challan
g. Consultants have MSME and Form C Certificate
h. Task Assignment, Manning Schedule, Methodology and Work Plan For Performing the Assignment
i. Consultants must have a well-established office from past 3 years. They should have experience in Building related works.
J. Certificates of proof shall be enclosed for the above.
all other conditions as per Bid Document (RFP)
